description_en: Creates a database account for a specified ApsaraDB for MongoDB instance and grants one or more database role permissions to the account
description_zh: 调用 CreateAccount 接口，为指定的云数据库 MongoDB 版实例创建数据库账号，并可为账号授予一个或多个数据库角色权限
kebab_example: aliyun dds create-account --db-instance-id dds-uf6e9433e955xxxx --account-name admin1 --account-password 'Test123456!' --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAccount

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. For a sharded cluster instance, specify the sharded cluster ID. Account operations are executed from the perspective of the ConfigServer
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。分片集群实例请传入分片集群ID，账号操作以config server视角执行
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The account name.
Regular expression: `^[a-z]+[a-z0-9|_]*[a-z0-9]+$`. The name must start with a lowercase letter, end with a lowercase letter or digit, and can contain lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_). The length must be 2 to 16 characters.
The reserved name `root` (case-insensitive, built-in system account) cannot be used.
The name cannot start with `__cloud` (reserved prefix for system accounts).
If the name is invalid, `InvalidAccountName.Malformed` is returned
parameters.help_zh:
账号名称。
正则：`^[a-z]+[a-z0-9|_]*[a-z0-9]+$`，即以小写字母开头、以小写字母或数字结尾，中间允许小写字母、数字、下划线（_），总长度 2~16 个字符。
禁止使用保留名 `root`（忽略大小写，系统自带账号，不可再建同名账号）。
禁止以 `__cloud` 开头（系统账号保留前缀）。
非法时返回 `InvalidAccountName.Malformed`
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en:
The account password.
The length must be 8 to 32 characters. It can contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and the following special characters: `!@#$%^&*()_+-=`.
The password must contain at least three of the following four character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters.
If the password is invalid, `InvalidAccountPassword.Malformed` is returned.


For information about how to handle special characters, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/471568.html
parameters.help_zh:
账号密码。
长度为 8~32 个字符；允许字符为大写字母、小写字母、数字及特殊字符 `!@#$%^&*()_+-=`。
必须至少包含大写字母、小写字母、数字、特殊字符四类中的三类。
非法时返回 `InvalidAccountPassword.Malformed`。


特殊字符的处理方法，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/471568.html
parameters.name: account_password

parameters.help_en:
The account type.
Valid values:
- `normal`: replica set account. For a replica set instance, any value is processed as `normal`.
- `cs`: sharded cluster ConfigServer account.
- `db`: sharded cluster Shard direct connection account. For a sharded cluster instance, any value other than `cs` is processed as `db`.
Default value: `db`
parameters.help_zh:
账号类型。
取值：
- `normal`：副本集账号（副本集实例传任何值均按 `normal` 处理）
- `cs`：分片集群 ConfigServer 账号
- `db`：分片集群 Shard 直连账号（分片实例传 `cs` 以外的值一律按 `db` 处理）
默认值：`db`
parameters.name: character_type

fields.help_en:
The database to which the account belongs (authentication database).
Default value: `admin`.
Rules: If this parameter is left empty, the request is allowed and the downstream system processes it as `admin`. If this parameter is specified, the length must be 1 to 63 characters. The value cannot contain `/`, `\`, `.`, spaces, `"`, or `$`, and cannot be `local`. Otherwise, `InvalidParameter` is returned
fields.help_zh:
账号所在库（鉴权库）。
缺省为 `admin`。
规则：为空放行（下游按 `admin` 处理）；非空时长度为 1~63 个字符，禁止包含 `/`、`\`、`.`、空格、`"`、`$`，且取值不能为 `local`，非法报 `InvalidParameter`
fields.name: db_name

fields.help_en: The role name. It can be a built-in role or a custom role created on the instance. For value rules, see Roles parameter description (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/mongodb/manage-database-accounts-through-the-console)
fields.help_zh: 角色名称。可以是内置角色或实例上已创建的自定义角色，取值规则请参见Roles参数描述 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/mongodb/manage-database-accounts-through-the-console?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-26556.d_2_4_0.463f1e24s7sunh&scm=20140722.H_3172083._.OR_help-T_cn~zh-V_1)
fields.name: role

parameters.help_en:
The list of authorization roles for the account. Required for replica set and ConfigServer (cs) accounts. Prohibited for sharded cluster Shard direct connection (db) accounts.
Globally prohibited (returns `InvalidRoles.NotAllowed`): `root`, `clusterAdmin`, `hostManager`, `clusterManager`, `__system`, `__queryableBackup`, and `restore`.
Can be authorized to any database (including admin): `read`, `userAdmin`, and `enableSharding`.
Can only be authorized to non-admin databases (returns `InvalidRoles.InvalidDB` if authorized to admin): `readWrite`, `dbAdmin`, and `dbOwner`.
Can only be authorized to the admin database: `readAnyDatabase`, `readWriteAnyDatabase`, `userAdminAnyDatabase`, `dbAdminAnyDatabase`, `clusterMonitor`, `backup`, and `alibabaCloudAdmin`. (`alibabaCloudAdmin` is supported only for instances with kernel version 4.4 or later. For earlier versions, `InvalidRoles.NotAllowed` is returned.)
Custom roles: Roles other than the preceding ones are considered custom roles and must already exist in the instance (you can query them by calling DescribeAccountRoles). Otherwise, `InvalidRoles.NotFound` is returned. `Roles.N.DBName` must be the same as the database where the role is defined. Otherwise, `InvalidRoles.DBNotMatch` is returned.
If `Roles` is missing as a whole, `MissingRoles` is returned. If `Roles.N.Role` and `Roles.N.DBName` do not appear in pairs, `InvalidRoles.Malformed` is returned. If `Roles` is passed for a sharded cluster Shard direct connection account, `InvalidRoles.NotSupported` is returned
parameters.help_zh:
账号授权角色列表。副本集 / cs 账号必填；分片 db 直连账号禁止传入。
全局禁止（返回 `InvalidRoles.NotAllowed`）：`root`、`clusterAdmin`、`hostManager`、`clusterManager`、`__system`、`__queryableBackup`、`restore`。
可授权到任意库（含 admin）：`read`、`userAdmin`、`enableSharding`。
仅可授权到非 admin 库（授权到 admin 返回 `InvalidRoles.InvalidDB`）：`readWrite`、`dbAdmin`、`dbOwner`。
仅可授权到 admin 库：`readAnyDatabase`、`readWriteAnyDatabase`、`userAdminAnyDatabase`、`dbAdminAnyDatabase`、`clusterMonitor`、`backup`、`alibabaCloudAdmin`（`alibabaCloudAdmin` 仅 4.4 及以上内核版本实例支持，低版本返回 `InvalidRoles.NotAllowed`）。
自定义角色：上述之外的角色视为自定义角色，须已存在于实例（可通过 DescribeAccountRoles 查询），否则返回 `InvalidRoles.NotFound`；`Roles.N.DBName` 必须等于该角色的定义库，否则返回 `InvalidRoles.DBNotMatch`。
`Roles` 整体缺失返回 `MissingRoles`；`Roles.N.Role` 与 `Roles.N.DBName` 未成对出现返回 `InvalidRoles.Malformed`；分片 db 直连账号传入 `Roles` 返回 `InvalidRoles.NotSupported`
parameters.name: roles

parameters.help_en:
The database to which the account belongs (authentication database).
Default value: `admin`.
Rules: If this parameter is left empty, the request is allowed and the downstream system processes it as `admin`. If this parameter is specified, the length must be 1 to 63 characters. The value cannot contain `/`, `\`, `.`, spaces, `"`, or `$`, and cannot be `local`. Otherwise, `InvalidParameter` is returned
parameters.help_zh:
账号所在库（鉴权库）。
缺省为 `admin`。
规则：为空放行（下游按 `admin` 处理）；非空时长度为 1~63 个字符，禁止包含 `/`、`\`、`.`、空格、`"`、`$`，且取值不能为 `local`，非法报 `InvalidParameter`
parameters.name: db_name

parameters.help_en:
The account description.

Regular expression: `^[a-zA-Z一-龥][a-zA-Z一-龥0-9_.-]{1,255}$`. The description must start with an English letter or Chinese character, followed by English letters, Chinese characters, digits, underscores (_), periods (.), or hyphens (-). The length must be 2 to 256 characters.
If the description is invalid, InvalidAccountDescription.Malformed is returned
parameters.help_zh:
账号备注。

正则：`^[a-zA-Z一-龥][a-zA-Z一-龥0-9_.-]{1,255}$`，即以英文字母或汉字开头，后接英文字母、汉字、数字、下划线（_）、英文句点（.）或短划线（-），总长度 2~256 个字符。
非法时返回 `InvalidAccountDescription.Malformed`
parameters.name: account_description
